The grand plan for revenge proceeded smoothly, with only one unexpected development—the way that person looked at him grew increasingly strange, shifting from initial vigilance and apprehension to something lingering and tender. Eventually, the boundary was crossed. In the dim interior room, the candlelight flickered. That person pressed down on him, wearing his former self’s face, whispering intimately while the pad of their finger pressed heavily against his neck.
“You plan to leave after using me? There’s no such easy deal in this world.” “In your heart, what exactly am I?” Si Cheng’s clothes were partially undone, a choked silence momentarily catching in his throat, unable to utter a word. But the other continued to murmur close to his ear. “As long as you don’t leave me.” “Whether it’s true feelings or pretense.” “I only ask that you… never leave me, okay?”
